what: Hovering a product card turns on a second photo square (220px, a different shot) at the spot where the pointer entered, over .7s power4.out, and it follows the cursor inside the card .7s late. The base photo grows 1.2x over 1s power4.out. On leave the square disappears over 1s and the photo returns to its size — like a small magnifier, a different shot floats over the card. Not applied on touch devices or with reduced-motion settings

from.where: index.html .in-thumb (product row cards — original .gsap_productsHover: cursor image 220px · .7s power4.out, background scale 1.2 1s power4.out)
